RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Spokane, WA operates under a 'strong mayor' or Mayor-Council form of government. The Mayor is the chief executive, and the City Council serves as the legislative body. The City Council consists of seven members, including a Council President elected at large and six council members elected by district. [3, 7]
